configuration.name: baseline_2026-08-04

case.notes: Spine position 3 confirmed by the user. Official clearances: CPU cooler 67 mm; GPU thickness 53 mm up to 131 mm GPU height or 43 mm up to 145 mm. Photos confirm the custom top fan is inside the case beneath the installed slotted grille; Terra has no official top mount. The bottom exhaust discharges into the approximately 20 mm foot gap above a solid desk.

geometry.modelling_rule: Known dimensions, fit-bounded inferences and assumptions are kept separate. This is a reduced-order/CFD-preparation geometry, not a manufacturing CAD model.

motherboard_telemetry.interpretation: measured secondary thermal state; no separate predictive board model accepted

configuration_screening.hypothesis: Reduces inlet pressure loss directly in front of the three GPU fans.
configuration_screening.main_risk: Fan-on-fan coupling may add noise and reduce rather than increase flow.

configuration_screening.hypothesis: Forces the GPU to ingest outside air and limits lateral leakage.
configuration_screening.main_risk: A guide placed too close to the fans may restrict flow and increase tonal noise.

configuration_screening.physical_change: Add two external top exhaust fans
configuration_screening.hypothesis: Attempts to reduce hot-air residence time inside the case.
configuration_screening.main_risk: Without spacing and sealing they may draw air from the surrounding exterior.

configuration_screening.physical_change: Add two external bottom intake fans
configuration_screening.hypothesis: Increases the cool make-up air available from below.
configuration_screening.main_risk: The narrow desk gap may restrict flow or cause recirculation.

configuration_screening.physical_change: Shorten and clear the cable path
configuration_screening.hypothesis: Reduces the porous obstruction around the PSU and central transfer path.
configuration_screening.main_risk: The change may be smaller than normal run-to-run variation.

configuration_screening.hypothesis: Tests whether a deliberate bottom-to-top path feeds the enclosure more effectively.
configuration_screening.main_risk: May recirculate hot air or fight the other fans.

configuration_screening.evidence_confidence: low for GPU; useful CPU experiment
configuration_screening.hypothesis: Improves CPU-cooler inlet conditions; its GPU effect is secondary.
configuration_screening.main_risk: May disturb the PSU and GPU flow paths.

configuration_screening.hypothesis: Reference configuration used to compare every proposed change.

warnings: Fan-location scenarios are screening intervals, not physically validated predictions.
System 2 RPM is considered invalid or incorrectly scaled.
No external temperature probes are used; shared-air behaviour remains inside the uncertainty bounds.
Unknown cooler, PSU and custom-fan dimensions are represented as bounded envelopes, never as exact CAD.
Raw logs remain the authoritative source for traceability.
